explanation: Many Hong Kong martial arts films were made in Cantonese, but this one is in Mandarin. As Taiwan's entry, it won Best Foreign Language Film among four Oscars.

claims.text: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000) is a Mandarin-language film.
Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon is not in Cantonese, Japanese or Korean.
Many Hong Kong martial arts films were made in Cantonese.
Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon won four Academy Awards, including Best Foreign Language Film.
The film was Taiwan's entry for the Best Foreign Language Film award.
